patterns.stats_card_pattern: Dashboard uses Card component in a grid with icon, label, and value. Each card has CardContent with flex layout, colored icon background, and responsive typography
patterns.client_component_pattern: All interactive components use 'use client' directive and hooks like useAuth, useState, useEffect
patterns.data_fetching_pattern: Use createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client for client-side data fetching
patterns.dark_mode: All components support dark mode with dark: prefix classes in Tailwind
patterns.turkish_ui: All UI text is in Turkish language

existing_implementations.description: getAllLimitStatuses() function already exists in lib/guards/limits.ts (lines 258-305). It returns LimitStatus[] with featureKey, currentCount, limit, isUnlimited, usagePercent, source, planName. Dashboard shows similar stats cards in a responsive grid layout.
